correctness.rationale: Exact conditioning on eight sign patterns gives the φ(q,v) law. Independent pair-difference symmetry proves probabilities 3/8, 1/8 and the relation t=3/8-v; cancellations eliminate auxiliary u. Reflection and normalization give all five masses. Exact endpoint cases q=0,1/2,1 and iid uniform/exponential magnitude laws are evaluated. A three-event disjointness argument and a log-uniform interpolation establish the sharp v range. The packaged stdlib checker passes 686 rational algebraic assertions; no finite check replaces the proof.

originality.rationale: The inspected full-text model paper proves universal survival and maximum-time laws but only reports numerical occupation-time nonuniversality in Section 6. Its assertion that the exponential law matches maximum-time statistics does not imply the one-scalar formula, sharp first horizon, or sharp range. A 2019 continuous-time run-and-tumble occupation law uses different sampling and dynamics. A 2021 permutation-generated walk concerns different increment dependence. published-finding corpus hits about four-step higher-order dependence affect Sparre-Andersen survival for non-iid signs, not this Markov-sign occupation-count classification. Priority remains uncertain for unindexed supplementary calculations.
